independent_audit.scope: Audit of retained captures/receipts/preserved native artifacts; current later native candidate was not used.

limitations: Native-only process: no original model or Torch is loaded.
Minor faults are fault events, not unique allocated pages; these counters do not attribute faults specifically to graph allocation.
System CPU time covers all kernel work and is not a measurement of page-fault latency.
CPU quota, dedicated capacity and host contention are unknown.
A single warmed call cannot establish comparative performance or qualify the backend.
The single measured native-only cache call was slower: 20.537758 s versus 19.925457 s. These observations are not original-versus-native qualification.
The six reference probes use 0.25-second raw inference. They do not establish the full overlapping pipeline fidelity or performance of all precisions and sizes.
Mapped-DSO endpoint inventories are not continuous monitoring, relocated-memory hashes, or complete relocation-binding proof.
This evidence is for the cache-only source hashes above; it does not test later recurrent-weight-cache candidates.
